dimensions.mechanical: PASS. Valid JSON, 245 unique keys, 245/245 key parity with en, no added or dropped keys, no duplicate members. @formatjs parsed every value; argument sets are identical to the English source for all 22 new keys: {device}/{reach}/{reason} (strings) and {count} (number). The two noun-headed countable chips carry one/many/other (all CLDR es categories); the three prepositional/adjectival chips are number-invariant and correctly use other only, matching accepted existing es patterns such as suspected_count/reached_count/no_answer_count. No markup, backticks, commands, flags or identifiers. No manual bidi controls; all values NFC; no leading/trailing or double spaces.
dimensions.accuracy: PASS. Every new key preserves the English meaning. No omissions or additions of instruction, no negation or polarity change. The refusal sentences state the reach word and the backend reason verbatim, then the same consequence as English ('nothing was moved' / 'could not hand this conversation over'). handshake_refused_hint keeps the source's epistemic limit: it says what to check, not an asserted cause. Safe wording for the refusal and membership copy.
dimensions.idiom_and_register: PASS. Reads as native neutral Spanish product copy, not a calque. Tú address in the hint, matching the es guide and the existing catalogue ('Espera a que termine el turno'). Sentence case; lowercase status fragments; heading 'Direcciones probadas' is sentence case, not Title Case. The refusal shape '{device}: {reach}{reason}, así que ...' deliberately mirrors the existing, unchanged mesh_drop.no_answer / owner_no_answer sentences ('{device} no responde{reason}, así que ...'). 'no se movió nada' and 'no pudo entregar esta conversación' are the house renderings; 'el par respondió, pero cerró el handshake' uses the correct comma before pero; 'época' is the established term in this catalogue.
dimensions.terminology: PASS. relay=relé (glossary), handshake kept English (es style guide's kept-English technical list), device=dispositivo, network=red, member=miembro/membresía, address=dirección, epoch=época; all consistent with the existing 223 keys. peer=par is used consistently in the three places it occurs (including the pre-existing mesh_list.answered_the_peer_read_but_is_in: 'la lectura del par'); 'par' is the settled Spanish networking term and the correct translation since the glossary/style guide do not keep 'peer' English. No product names in the new copy.
dimensions.fit: PASS by source inspection. ui.mesh.context.json defines no maxCells or maxChars for these keys. The longest new per-address label is 'ningún servicio escucha' (23 chars) in a 320px card (w-80, p-4, ~288px content) whose endpoint cell is min-w-0 truncate while the label is shrink-0; the label fits and the endpoint truncates, so no overflow. The two headlines and the hint are full-width paragraphs that wrap; the census chips are in a wrapping paragraph. Short labels expand more than the style guide's 15-25% guide (attempt_bad_address 11→18 chars, +64%), but every one is at most 23 chars and fits the 288px row; no button/tab/status-line candidate overflows. The hint is +8% in characters.
dimensions.rtl: N/A for es (LTR). Scanned every new value for U+200E/U+200F/U+202A-U+202E/U+2066-U+2069/U+061C and other Unicode Cf controls: zero.
dimensions.nfc: PASS. Every new value is NFC-normalised (unicodedata.normalize check); no combining-mark surprises, no NBSP, U+202F, zero-width or BOM characters.
